# Jordan Kanter

> The personal site of Jordan Kanter -- Jordan Kanter is a Chicago-based AI, data, and product consultant with 20+ years of enterprise experience helping Fortune 500 brands turn data into outcomes.. Essays and notes on artificial intelligence, customer data, and product strategy.

Jordan Kanter is a Jordan Kanter is a Chicago-based AI, data, and product consultant with over 20 years of experience in enterprise technology. He has led AI, data, and product efforts for leading brands including Kaiser Permanente, TD Ameritrade, Fossil, The Hartford, United Airlines, Qualcomm, Intercontinental Hotels Group, and Hyundai, helping them optimize their presence with data across channels. His work spans the healthcare, financial services, retail, and technology sectors, and he holds AWS, Azure, and Databricks certifications.

The full text of every page and post is also available as a single file: [llms-full.txt](https://jordankanter.com/llms-full.txt). Each page below additionally has a plain-Markdown version at the same URL with a `.md` extension.
